text: Cwblhewch y dywediad: ‘Cenedl heb iaith, cenedl heb …’
gloss: Complete the saying: 'A nation without a language, a nation without a…' — heart: «Cenedl heb iaith, cenedl heb galon».

text: Mae baner Cymru'n wyrdd a gwyn, ond pa liw yw'r ddraig sydd arni?
gloss: The Welsh flag is green and white, but what colour is the dragon on it? — Red: Y Ddraig Goch.

text: Ystyr ‘brith’ yw ‘smotiog’. Beth sy'n rhoi i fara brith ei smotiau?
gloss: 'Brith' means speckled. What gives bara brith its speckles? — Dried fruit soaked in tea.

text: Pa nwy y mae planhigion yn ei dynnu o'r aer i wneud eu bwyd yng ngolau'r haul?
gloss: Which gas do plants take from the air to make food in sunlight? — Carbon dioxide (photosynthesis); oxygen is what they give off.

text: Pa flodyn melyn y mae llawer o bobl yn ei wisgo ar Ddydd Gŵyl Dewi?
gloss: Which yellow flower do many people wear on St David's Day? — The daffodil, 'Peter's leek' in Welsh; primrose and dandelion are yellow too.

text: Beth yw'r enw Cymraeg ar yr afon sy'n llifo drwy ganol Llundain?
gloss: What is the Welsh name of the river through central London? — Tafwys, the Thames.

text: Dim ond defaid ac ieir sydd mewn cae. Mae tair dafad yno, ac mae 20 coes yn y cae i gyd. Sawl iâr sydd yno?
gloss: Only sheep and hens in a field: three sheep and 20 legs in all. How many hens? — 4: the sheep have 12 legs, the remaining 8 belong to 4 hens. 8 is the autopilot trap.

text: Ar fysellfwrdd cyfrifiadur arferol ym Mhrydain, pa chwe llythyren sydd ar ddechrau'r rhes uchaf o lythrennau?
gloss: On a standard British keyboard, which six letters begin the top letter row? — QWERTY; AZERTY is French, QWERTZ German.

text: Mae gennych dri darn 20c a dau ddarn 50c. Faint o arian sydd gennych i gyd?
gloss: You have three 20p coins and two 50p coins. How much in all? — £1.60: 60p + £1.

text: Nid pryfyn yw'r pry cop — mae gan bryfed chwe choes. Sawl coes sydd gan bry cop?
gloss: A spider is not an insect — insects have six legs. How many legs does a spider have? — 8 (it is an arachnid), even though Welsh calls it 'pry'.

text: Yn yr wyddor Gymraeg, mae ambell lythyren yn cael ei hysgrifennu â dau nod. Sawl llythyren sydd yn y gair ‘llong’?
gloss: In the Welsh alphabet some letters are written with two characters. How many letters in 'llong' (ship)? — 3: ll-o-ng, both ll and ng are single letters.

text: Mae enwau rhai o ddyddiau'r wythnos yn Gymraeg yn enwau planedau hefyd. Pa ddiwrnod sy'n rhannu ei enw â'r blaned agosaf at yr Haul?
gloss: Some Welsh weekday names are also planet names. Which day shares its name with the planet closest to the Sun? — Wednesday: Mercher = Mercury. Gwener (Venus) is the second planet, the trap.

text: Mae afon hiraf Prydain yn tarddu ar Bumlumon ac yn cyrraedd y môr ger Bryste. Pa afon yw hi?
gloss: Britain's longest river rises on Plynlimon and reaches the sea near Bristol. Which? — The Severn. The Wye also rises on Plynlimon, the trap.

text: Cafodd ei eni yn Llandaf, Caerdydd, i rieni o Norwy, ac ef a greodd Matilda a Willy Wonka. Pwy ydyw?
gloss: Born in Llandaff, Cardiff, to Norwegian parents, he created Matilda and Willy Wonka. Who? — Roald Dahl (born 1916).

text: Mae ffens syth 20 metr o hyd, gyda pholyn bob 5 metr, gan gynnwys un ym mhob pen. Sawl polyn sydd ynddi?
gloss: A straight fence 20 m long has a post every 5 m, including one at each end. How many posts? — 5: four gaps need five posts; 4 is the autopilot answer.

text: Pa un o'r rhain a ddigwyddodd gyntaf?
options: Galwad ffôn gyntaf Alexander Graham Bell
gloss: Which of these happened first? — Bell's first telephone call (1876), before the Wright brothers (1903), the Moon landing (1969) and the first iPhone (2007).

text: Pa gyfarwyddwr a wnaeth ‘Jaws’, ‘E.T.’ a ‘Jurassic Park’?
gloss: Which director made Jaws, E.T. and Jurassic Park? — Steven Spielberg.

text: Pa ffrwyth yw sylfaen y dip Mecsicanaidd guacamole?
gloss: Which fruit is the base of the Mexican dip guacamole? — Avocado.

text: Pa aderyn sy'n dodwy ei wyau yn nythod adar eraill, gan adael iddyn nhw fagu ei gywion?
gloss: Which bird lays its eggs in other birds' nests and leaves them to raise its chicks? — The cuckoo.

text: Ym mha bentref dychmygol yn y Cymoedd mae Sam Tân yn byw ac yn gweithio?
gloss: In which fictional Valleys village does Fireman Sam live and work? — Pontypandy (a blend of Pontypridd and Tonypandy). Llareggub is Dylan Thomas's village in Under Milk Wood.

text: Yn yr hen ddull Cymraeg o gyfrif, mae ‘ar hugain’ yn golygu ‘ar ben ugain’. Pa rif yw ‘un ar bymtheg ar hugain’?
gloss: In the traditional Welsh count, 'ar hugain' means 'on top of twenty'. What is 'one on fifteen on twenty'? — 36: 1 + 15 + 20. 16 is the trap for stopping halfway.

text: Ym 1588 cyhoeddwyd y Beibl cyfan yn Gymraeg am y tro cyntaf, gan roi hwb mawr i'r iaith. Pwy a'i cyfieithodd?
gloss: In 1588 the whole Bible was published in Welsh for the first time. Who translated it? — William Morgan. Salesbury (the trap) translated the New Testament in 1567.

text: Mae ciwb iâ'n arnofio mewn gwydraid o ddŵr sy'n llawn hyd at yr ymyl. Beth sy'n digwydd wrth i'r iâ doddi?
options: Mae'r lefel yn aros yr un fath
Mae'r dŵr yn gorlifo dros yr ymyl
Mae'r lefel yn gostwng yn amlwg
gloss: An ice cube floats in a glass filled to the brim. What happens as it melts? — The level stays the same: floating ice displaces exactly its own weight of water (Archimedes).

text: Mae enw Aberdaugleddau yn Sir Benfro yn dweud sawl afon sy'n cwrdd yn yr aber. Sawl un?
gloss: The name Aberdaugleddau (Milford Haven) tells how many rivers meet in its estuary. How many? — Two: 'aber' + 'dau' + 'Cleddau', the Eastern and Western Cleddau.

text: Pa gapten sy'n hela'r morfil gwyn yn nofel Herman Melville?
gloss: Which captain hunts the white whale in Herman Melville's novel? — Ahab (Moby-Dick); the others are fictional captains too.

text: Bwâu pigfain a ffenestri lliw uchel mewn eglwysi cadeiriol canoloesol: pa arddull bensaernïol yw hon?
gloss: Pointed arches and tall stained-glass windows in medieval cathedrals: which style? — Gothic. Romanesque, its predecessor, has round arches.

text: Pa gyfenw oedd gan y tad a'r mab o Bontypridd a luniodd ‘Hen Wlad fy Nhadau’ ym 1856?
gloss: What surname did the Pontypridd father and son who wrote the national anthem in 1856 share? — James: Evan James (words) and James James (tune). 'Evans' tempts those who half-remember 'Evan'.

text: Mae enw gwraig Lleu Llaw Gyffes yn y Mabinogi yn datgelu o beth y crëwyd hi gan Math a Gwydion. O beth?
gloss: The name of Lleu Llaw Gyffes's wife in the Mabinogi reveals what Math and Gwydion made her from. What? — Flowers: Blodeuwedd, 'flower-face', made of oak blossom, broom and meadowsweet. Knowing the name plus reading it gives the answer.

text: Mewn snwcer, beth yw'r egwyl uchaf bosibl fel arfer: pob coch gyda'r ddu, ac yna'r lliwiau i gyd?
gloss: In snooker, what is the usual maximum break: every red with the black, then all the colours? — 147: 15 × (1 + 7) = 120, plus 2+3+4+5+6+7 = 27.

text: Dyfeisiodd Tim Berners-Lee y We Fyd-Eang tra oedd yn gweithio yn labordy CERN. Ger pa ddinas mae'r labordy hwnnw?
gloss: Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web while working at CERN. Near which city is it? — Geneva.

text: Yn y darlun ‘Salem’ (1908), mae rhai'n gweld wyneb y diafol ym mhlygion siôl Siân Owen. Pwy a'i paentiodd?
gloss: In the painting 'Salem' (1908), some see the devil's face in the folds of Siân Owen's shawl. Who painted it? — Sydney Curnow Vosper.

text: Nid oes gan y môr hwn yng Ngogledd yr Iwerydd arfordir o gwbl: ceryntau'r cefnfor yw ei ffiniau. Pa fôr yw hwn?
gloss: This North Atlantic sea has no coastline at all: ocean currents are its borders. Which sea? — The Sargasso Sea.

text: Sawl symudiad sydd i gyd yn ‘Y Pedwar Tymor’ gan Vivaldi?
gloss: How many movements in all in Vivaldi's The Four Seasons? — 12: four violin concertos of three movements each. 4 is the autopilot answer.

text: Roedd Owain Tudur, o deulu Penmynydd ym Môn, yn daid i ba frenin?
gloss: Owen Tudor, of the Penmynydd family on Anglesey, was grandfather of which king? — Henry VII, son of Edmund Tudor. Henry VIII was his great-grandson.

text: Mae gan bob atom carbon chwe phroton. Sawl niwtron sydd mewn atom carbon-14?
gloss: Every carbon atom has six protons. How many neutrons in carbon-14? — 8: the 14 counts protons plus neutrons, 14 − 6 = 8.

text: Mae enw hir pentref ar Ynys Môn yn gorffen â ‘…llantysiliogogogoch’. At beth y mae'r ‘gogogoch’ yn cyfeirio?
gloss: The long Anglesey village name ends '…llantysiliogogogoch'. What does 'gogogoch' refer to? — The red cave: '(church of) Tysilio of the red cave', 'gogo' from 'ogof'. 'Y gog goch' (red cuckoo) is the sound-alike trap.

text: Mewn golff, beth yw ystyr ‘albatros’ ar un twll?
options: Tair ergyd o dan y par
Un ergyd o dan y par
Dwy ergyd o dan y par
Pedair ergyd o dan y par
gloss: In golf, what does 'albatross' on a hole mean? — Three under par. Birdie is one, eagle two; the bigger the bird, the better the score.

text: Pa fath o grwst a ddefnyddir i wneud éclairs?
gloss: What kind of pastry are éclairs made from? — Choux pastry (also used for profiteroles).

text: Mae gan octopws wyth braich — ond sawl calon sydd ganddo?
gloss: An octopus has eight arms — but how many hearts? — Three: one main heart and two for the gills.

text: Ysgrifennodd hi'r hyn a ystyrir yn aml yn rhaglen gyfrifiadurol gyntaf, ar gyfer Peiriant Dadansoddol Charles Babbage. Pwy oedd hi?
gloss: She wrote what is often considered the first computer program, for Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine. Who? — Ada Lovelace (1843).

text: Ym mha ddrama gan Shakespeare y mae'r Cymro balch Fluellen yn gwneud i Pistol fwyta cenhinen?
gloss: In which Shakespeare play does the proud Welshman Fluellen make Pistol eat a leek? — Henry V. Henry IV Part 1 is the trap: it has Glendower.

text: Ym 1176 cynhaliwyd gŵyl o feirdd a cherddorion yng nghastell Aberteifi, yr eisteddfod gyntaf a gofnodwyd. Pwy a'i trefnodd?
gloss: In 1176 a festival of poets and musicians was held at Cardigan castle, the first recorded eisteddfod. Who organised it? — The Lord Rhys (Rhys ap Gruffydd).

text: Pa un o'r prifddinasoedd hyn sydd bellaf i'r gogledd?
gloss: Which of these capitals is furthest north? — Edinburgh (55.95° N), just north of Moscow (55.76°) and Copenhagen (55.68°); Vilnius is 54.7°.

text: Pa gyfansoddwr o Ferthyr Tudful a ysgrifennodd yr emyn-dôn ‘Aberystwyth’ a ‘Blodwen’, yr opera Gymraeg gyntaf?
gloss: Which Merthyr Tydfil composer wrote the hymn tune 'Aberystwyth' and 'Blodwen', the first Welsh-language opera? — Joseph Parry (Blodwen, 1878).

text: Pa arlunydd a aned yn Hwlffordd, a dreuliodd ran helaeth o'i hoes yn Ffrainc, ac a fu'n fodel i'r cerflunydd Auguste Rodin?
gloss: Which artist, born in Haverfordwest, spent much of her life in France and modelled for the sculptor Auguste Rodin? — Gwen John.

text: Ym 1958 collodd Cymru o 1–0 i Frasil yn rownd yr wyth olaf Cwpan y Byd. Pwy sgoriodd y gôl, ei gôl gyntaf erioed yng Nghwpan y Byd?
gloss: In 1958 Wales lost 1–0 to Brazil in the World Cup quarter-final. Who scored, his first ever World Cup goal? — Pelé, aged 17.

text: Sawl gwerth gwahanol y gall un beit eu cynrychioli?
gloss: How many different values can one byte represent? — 256: a byte is 8 bits, 2⁸ = 256. 255 is the trap (the largest value, counting from 0).

text: Sawl cromosom sydd mewn cell wy ddynol iach cyn iddi gael ei ffrwythloni?
gloss: How many chromosomes in a healthy human egg cell before fertilisation? — 23: body cells have 46, and a sex cell carries half.

text: Pa gymeriad sy'n ymddangos ym mhob un o Bedair Cainc y Mabinogi?
gloss: Which character appears in all four Branches of the Mabinogi? — Pryderi: born in the first, a survivor in the second, central in the third, killed in the fourth.

text: Pa elfen sydd â'r symbol cemegol W?
gloss: Which element has the chemical symbol W? — Tungsten, from its German name Wolfram. Uranium (Wraniwm in Welsh) is the trap: its symbol is U.
